subject: Intro: budget nominee and security evidence request
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@vitalcore.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@vitalcore.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: budget nominee and security evidence request

Hi Priya / Samir — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can keep momentum: 

Call recap (very short)
- Goal: Pilot Redwood Inference on VitalCore search pipelines to reduce index-time embedding costs and improve query latency for customer support use cases.
- Scope discussed: 3 models (chat + embeddings), ~2M tokens/month initial pilot, SSO + limited data retention.

Open items / asks
1) Budget owner: Priya, can you confirm whether you will be the budget approver for this engagement? If not, please nominate who signs.
2) Procurement timeline: looping in procurement (cc'd procurement@vitalcore.com) — what is the typical PO timeline and any mandatory PO/contract templates we should expect?
3) Security evidence: procurement/security will want SOC 2 summary, data handling clauses, and SSO/SCIM info. Can you point me to the right person on your side, or would you prefer we send a short packet first?

Proposed next steps
- I can send a 1-page SOC2 summary and a PO template we use (attached).
- If Priya confirms budget ownership, can we schedule a 30-min procurement + budget-owner sync next week (I suggested Tue/Wed morning PT)?

Attachments: SOC2_summary.pdf (short scope + auditor) ; Redwood-PO-template.docx

Thanks — I'll wait on Priya's confirmation and will schedule once we have the procurement contact/time.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0147
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@vitalcore.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@vitalcore.com>
Cc: procurement@vitalcore.com, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@vitalcore.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 10:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro: budget nominee and security evidence request

Hi Diego — thanks for the recap. Confirming: I am the budget owner for this pilot. Samir is helping with technical validation.

Procurement note: We have an internal procurement lead (Liam O'Neill, cc'd) who will manage the PO and standard vendor checks. Typical timeline: procurement review + legal redlines usually takes 5-7 business days once they have the vendor packet. If we can provide the SOC 2 summary and a PO template today, that will let Liam start the queue.

Security contact: Liam handles procurement, but for deeper security review we typically open a ticket with our Security team; Liam will coordinate that once he has the SOC2 summary.

Proposed times for a short sync with procurement + me: Tue 18 Mar 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 19 Mar 09:00-09:30 PT. Either works for me.

Thanks — attaching any quick notes here in-line.

Regards,
Priya Singh
Director of Platform Partnerships | VitalCore
